title: Implement E1S native display and scanout ownership
acceptance: Compile/link real DECON/DPP/DSIM/DSC, panel reset/rails/clocks/TE and brightness support against pinned XNU; start with verified 60 Hz profile
Resolve actual boot framebuffer ownership/format/stride/reservations/cache and DPU SysMMU mappings; reject guessed fallback addresses or fake VSYNC as native readiness
Enforce producer fences and source/destination/scanout lifetime, bounded queue cancellation/fault/Stop; timeout cannot show an unfinished GPU surface or authorize reuse
Qualify hardware TE/frame-done/retirement and panel power separately on the native S24; source/build checks cannot satisfy them
steps: Match selected pinned inputs and ownership boundaries
Implement actual backend/frontend without success stubs
Compile/link and test bounded failure/lifecycle paths; retain native qualification gates
